scope: Complete supplied 48-dimensional planar and61-dimensional nonplanar gg-to-Hg canonical systems, through epsilon4, one regular non-grid W point; no complete form-factor, helicity, automatic-boundary or automatic-topology-reduction claim.

source_accuracy.absolute_error_envelope: 1e-26 per inexact source component; exact source values retain zero

validation.coefficient_accuracy_metric: For every coefficient, the estimated absolute complex error is <=10^(-verified_digits)*max(1,abs(coefficient));21 is a scaled absolute/relative metric, not21 significant digits for small nonzero coefficients.

root_convention.physical_prescription: +i0 as in original supplied physical boundary
root_convention.mapping: At this regular W segment only sqrt(-b) is opposite-principal. Negative multivariate NP radicands remain principal; reviewed against original threshold replacement.
root_convention.export_validation: Every rooted letter is substituted back to its exact expanded radicand power and passes Mathematica SameQ; root index match restricted to top-level radicands.

native_result.scope: Full48/61 supplied-system W regular-point transport through epsilon4, original comparison, refinement and binary restart; no FF/amplitude or automatic-boundary claim

native_provenance.scope: Frozen target-only full48/61 canonical physical-cache check; copied implementations from completed full13 canonical experiment, common types linked to immutable archived library, old dependency search directory added after currentRustRed metadata rebuild. No mutable production source included.

rejected_attempt.reason: Target-only exporter initially searched within root expressions and conflated distinct radicands. Native rejected an identically zero letter before arithmetic. Corrected top-level lookup and exact roundtrip; rejected artifacts preserved and excluded from validation.
